richiami.difetto: The control module for heater blower speed may overheat during prolonged use. The plastic body may melt and in extreme instances cause a fire.

It has been identified that the integral clip-tabs on the hood louver may fracture causing the hood louver to lose its retention mechanism. This will result in noise from the loss hood louver which should identify the issue to the driver. If this indicator is unnoticed then detachment could occur which could cause injury and/or property damage.
richiami.rimedio: Apply an adhesive to the hood louver (hood air grill panel) to secure it to the hood.

richiami.difetto: null The product poses a risk of injuries because the clip-tabs securing the bonnet louvre may fracture. This may result in the louvre coming loose while the vehicle is in motion and turning into a dangerous projectile that could strike another vehicle.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: EC type-approval: e13*2001/116*0209*00, type GMT345. The vehicles concerned were built between 2006 and 2010.
